statement: Let r be the signed integer value of the returned I64. Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. If there exists an integer i such that 0 <= i <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[i+j] = needle[j], then r is the least such i (as an integer value); otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: Let r be the signed integer value of the returned I64. Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 0 <= r <= len(haystack) - len(needle).
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: Let r be the signed integer value of the returned I64. Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 0, then 0 <= r <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[r+j] = needle[j].
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: Let r be the signed integer value of the returned I64. Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 0, for every integer i with 0 <= i < r, it is not the case that (0 <= i <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[i+j] = needle[j]).
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: If there is no integer i such that 0 <= i <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[i+j] = needle[j], then whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: Let r be the signed integer value of the returned I64. For every integer k, if 0 <= k <= len(haystack) - len(needle), and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle) we have haystack[k+j] = needle[j], and for every integer i with 0 <= i < k it is not the case that (0 <= i <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle) we have haystack[i+j] = needle[j]), then whenever the function returns a result r, r = k.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: For every integer k such that 0 <= k <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[k+j] = needle[j], whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0 and r <= k.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 10000, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).

statement: Let r be the signed integer value returned by str_str(haystack, needle) and r' be the signed integer value returned by str_str(haystack ++ [b], needle). For every byte b with 97 <= b <= 122, if there exists an integer i such that 0 <= i <= len(haystack) - len(needle) and for every integer j with 0 <= j < len(needle), haystack[i+j] = needle[j], then whenever both calls return results, r' = r.
preconditions: len(haystack) >= 1, len(needle) >= 1, len(haystack) <= 9999, len(needle) <= 10000, and every byte of haystack and needle is between 97 and 122 inclusive (lowercase ASCII).
